fast_samples.method: hidden Default seed12345 speed8 until simTime900; polled every ~0.25 s wall (~100 ticks), all live bibite x/y/energy/health, nearest pellet from full pellet map, contact/stomach counters

capture.nearest_plant_note: nearest pellet computed from the full map at each sample (not a 50 u cut)

feeding_counters.note_exact: Harmony hooks: produced = SpawnAPellet returned energy; consumed/recycled/decayed = pellet energy removed outside/inside Zone.RecyclePellets/MatterDecayProcessor.FixedUpdate. culled_energy is 0 today (all destroy paths are amount-based); residual ~0 modulo polls.
feeding_counters.note: polling census: produced = new pellet energy; removed/culled = residual energy of pellets gone between polls; recycled/decayed cannot be split by polling and are null; consumed_energy_estimate = initial + produced - current - removed. Exact accumulators are the task-94 appendix-D follow-up.
